name: Yantian District

queries.query: Yantian District Shenzhen official cadastral parcel map GIS API land registry
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Shenzhen Real Estate Registration Center cadastral-map query service. Its official page states that the service covers all Shenzhen except the Shenzhen-Shantou Special Cooperation Zone, is publicly queryable, is updated in real time, and provides parcel boundaries, parcel number/code, area, use, and location; it identifies Shenzhen Planning and Natural Resources Bureau as mapping authority and CGCS2000 as the coordinate system.

queries.query: 盐田区 深圳 官方 不动产 登记 地图 地籍图 GIS 服务
queries.result: 第一方检索发现深圳市不动产登记中心的官方地籍图查询系统。官方页面说明查询范围为深圳市全市域（不含深汕合作区），任何人可查询，数据实时更新，并可查看宗地边界、宗地号和宗地代码、土地面积、土地用途、土地位置；制图单位为深圳市规划和自然资源局，坐标系为CGCS2000。
